_note: Hand-derived JSON Schema for the OCSF v1.1.0 base_event envelope, scoped to the attributes that are required with no profile applied (fetched from https://schema.ocsf.io/api/1.1.0/classes/base_event?profiles=, https://schema.ocsf.io/api/1.1.0/objects/metadata?profiles=, and https://schema.ocsf.io/api/1.1.0/objects/product?profiles= on 2026-07-14). base_event's class-specific profile attributes (user, actor, cloud, device, api, finding_info, ...) are NOT included here: those are required only when the class or an activated profile requires them, and OCSF's own base_event export marks them required only under a `profile` gate, not unconditionally. This schema pins the unconditional envelope contract every OCSF v1.1.0 record satisfies, plus the value-level type and enum constraints (the OCSF severity_id dictionary enum, in particular) that a hand-picked key-presence check cannot catch.

category_uid.description: OCSF category identifier the class belongs to.

activity_id.description: OCSF activity identifier within the class.

type_uid.description: OCSF composite type identifier: class_uid * 100 + activity_id.

time.description: Event time as OCSF timestamp_t: UNIX epoch milliseconds, not ISO 8601.

severity_id.description: The published OCSF v1.1.0 severity_id dictionary enum: Unknown(0), Informational(1), Low(2), Medium(3), High(4), Critical(5), Fatal(6), Other(99).

version.description: The OCSF wire schema version this record was serialized against.
